an4.202:3.3: They themselves are shameless, and they encourage others to be shameless too;
an4.202:3.4: They themselves are imprudent, and they encourage others to be imprudent too;
an4.202:3.5: They themselves have little learning, and they encourage others to have little learning too;
an4.202:3.6: They themselves are lazy, and they encourage others to be lazy too;
an4.202:3.7: They themselves are unmindful, and they encourage others to be unmindful too;
an4.202:3.8: They themselves are witless, and they encourage others to be witless too.
an4.202:5.3: They themselves are conscientious, and they encourage others to be conscientious too;
an4.202:5.4: They themselves are prudent, and they encourage others to be prudent too;
an4.202:5.5: They themselves have learned much, and they encourage others to learn much too;
an4.202:5.6: They themselves are energetic, and they encourage others to be energetic too;
an4.202:5.7: They themselves have established mindfulness, and they encourage others to establish mindfulness too;
an4.202:5.8: They themselves are personally accomplished in wisdom, and they encourage others to be accomplished in wisdom too.
